description_zh: Cruise AV 在 14th St 向东直行，另一辆车从右侧相邻车道切入其车道，导致侧擦碰撞。选择 Cruise AV 为 ego 测试其对 cut-in 的反应，NPC 为切入车辆。

source_snippets: A Cruise autonomous vehicle (“Cruise AV”), operating in autonomous mode, was traveling eastbound on 14th Street at the intersection with Valencia Street when another vehicle began to change into the Cruise AV’s lane.
the other vehicle made contact with the right front corner of the Cruise AV
VEH 1 MOVEMENT: PROCEEDING STRAIGHT; VEH 2 MOVEMENT: CHANGING LANES; TYPE OF COLLISION: SIDE SWIPE
evidence.reason: 典型 cut-in 场景，ego 直行，NPC 从右侧相邻车道切入，现有词汇表可表达。
